renewal_right.quote: A tenancy to which this Part of this Act applies shall not come to an end unless terminated in accordance with the provisions of this Part of this Act

landlord_notice_months.quote: not more than twelve nor less than six months before the date of the termination specified therein

tenant_request_months.quote: not more than twelve nor less than six months after the making of the request

new_tenancy_years_max.quote: a tenancy for a term not exceeding fifteen years

compensation_rateable_value.quote: twice the rateable value of the holding (s.37(2)(a)); the appropriate multiplier for the purposes of section 37(2) is (a) 1 (SI 1990/363, article 4)

contracting_out_notice_days.quote: must be served on the tenant not less than 14 days before the tenant enters into the tenancy to which it applies, or (if earlier) becomes contractually bound to do so.

short_tenancy_months.quote: does not apply to a tenancy granted for a term certain not exceeding six months unless

registration_over_years.quote: for a term of years absolute of more than seven years from the date of the grant

registration_months.quote: The period for registration is 2 months beginning with the date on which the relevant event occurs

registration_fee_gbp.quote: Schedule 1, Scale 1, the row 0-80,000 / 20 / 45 / 30 (the third column applies to leases)

sdlt_return_days.quote: Send an SDLT return to HMRC and pay the tax within 14 days of completion.

vat_on_rent.quote: Supplies of land and buildings, such as freehold sales, leasing or renting, are normally exempt from VAT. Once you have opted to tax all the supplies you make of your interest in the land or buildings will normally be standard-rated

dilapidations_cap.value: the fall in the value of the landlord's interest
dilapidations_cap.quote: shall in no case exceed the amount (if any) by which the value of the reversion (whether immediate or not) in the premises is diminished owing to the breach of such covenant or agreement

dilapidations_schedule_days.quote: What is a reasonable time will vary from case to case, but will generally be within 56 days after the termination of the tenancy.
